overview: Based on the published agenda, the Utility Committee of Kronenwetter was scheduled to review financial statements and a Director of Public Works and Utilities report, and to consider matters related to a water tower cell phone lease, capital improvement planning, and Lift Station 8 operations.

agenda.item: Director of Public Works and Utilities Report
Water Tower Cell Phone Lease Information

discussions.body: The committee was scheduled to review financial statements as part of routine reporting on utility operations and fiscal matters.

discussions.item: Director of Public Works and Utilities Report
discussions.body: The committee was set to receive a report from the Director of Public Works and Utilities covering operational matters within their department.

discussions.item: Water Tower Cell Phone Lease Information
discussions.body: The committee was scheduled to discuss information regarding a cell phone lease arrangement for the water tower facility, with potential action expected.
The committee was set to discuss the Capital Improvement Plan, which was expected to address planned infrastructure projects and improvements for the village.
The committee was scheduled to review information concerning Lift Station 8 operations, with potential discussion and action anticipated.

publicComment: Public comment was on the agenda, limited to 15 minutes total with a three-minute time period per person, at the discretion of the Chief Presiding Officer.
actionItems: Expected to consider action on water tower cell phone lease information
Expected to discuss and potentially act on CIP matters
Expected to consider action on Lift Station 8 information
title: Utility Committee Meeting - 2026-08-04
